output.summary: The claim was denied because the member has not met the 12‑month maternity waiting period. Gather additional enrollment proof and follow the escalation steps, noting that no appeal basis exists under the current gate.

items.text: Provide documentation confirming continuous enrollment for the full 12‑month waiting period.
Compile a summary of the enrollment record and the 10 months of coverage and forward to the escalation team as required by the waiting‑period clause.
Precedent F-MATERNITY-9M is inapplicable because it addresses version‑drift under a later clause (C-2026-MATERNITY-WAIT) and does not change the 12‑month requirement in our current policy version.
The gate WAITING_NOT_MET indicates there is no appeal basis under the current policy.
